title: Application of HIV-1 viral protein R-derived-peptides as new E3 ligase-binding components of BRD4 degraders
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00125K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kohei Tsuji, Xueyuan Huang, Maho Miyamoto, Sayaka Sukegawa, Hidetomo Yokoo, Hiroaki Takeuchi, Yosuke Demizu, Hirokazu Tamamura
An HIV-1 accessory protein Vpr-derived peptide functions as an E3 ligase ligand, and this peptide-containing molecules successfully degraded their target protein, BRD4. These molecules also showed HIV-1 latency reversing activity.
